title: 7-Day Hanoi Heritage & Mountain Championship Golf
description: Championship northern Vietnam golf tour. Play BRG Legend Hill, Sky Lake (Lake Course), Silk Path Dong Trieu, and Thanh Lanh Valley, staying at Capella Hanoi.

signatureTour.title: The Emperor’s Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Our flagship northern Vietnam signature tour featuring exclusive Michelin-star dining, helicopter transfers, and luxury lake retreats.

featuredVenues.name: Sky Lake Lake Course
featuredVenues.badge: Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design

inclusions.detail: Private luxury executive transport for all airport, hotel, and golf course routes.
4 championship rounds at Legend Hill, Sky Lake (Lake Course), Silk Path Dong Trieu, and Thanh Lanh Valley.
6 nights in Premier Opera Suites at Capella Hanoi.
Dedicated personal caddie and twin-share buggy included for every round.
24/7 on-ground assistance for tee times, caddie staging, and Michelin dining bookings.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi & Opera District Check-In at Capella Hanoi
itinerary.subtitle: Capital Arrival
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) where your private chauffeur meets your party and transfers you to Capella Hanoi, Bill Bensley's theatrical boutique masterpiece celebrating the golden age of opera. Check in to your Premier Suite and decompress.

In the evening, gather in the Living Room for Capella's signature aperitivo hour, followed by a welcome dinner exploring Hanoi's refined culinary heritage in the historic French Quarter.

itinerary.title: Twin Green Architecture at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Nicklaus Twin Green Concept
itinerary.imageCaption: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort — Nicklaus Design (Par 72, 7,068 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort championship golf course Nicklaus Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort, Jack Nicklaus’s first design in Vietnam. The course is celebrated for its unique twin-green concept, presenting distinct tactical challenges and pin positions on every hole across rolling foothills.

Enjoy lunch in the modern clubhouse overlooking the lakes before returning to Hanoi for an afternoon exploring the ancient streets of the Old Quarter.

itinerary.title: Northern Vietnam’s Toughest Test: Sky Lake (Lake Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Tournament Challenge
itinerary.architect: Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design
itinerary.imageCaption: Sky Lake Lake Course — Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design (Par 72, 6,987 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Sky Lake Lake Course championship golf course Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on the championship Lake Course at Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club. Frequently ranked among Vietnam’s toughest championship layouts, this par-72 test features dramatic elevation shifts, deep fairway bunkering, and natural lake carries.

Celebrate a hard-fought round with drinks in the members' lounge before your private driver whisks you back to Capella Hanoi for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Hanoi Cultural Immersion & French Quarter Gastronomy
itinerary.subtitle: Capital Rest Day
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A dedicated rest day in the capital. Enjoy breakfast at Backstage, followed by an optional private guided tour of the Temple of Literature, the Vietnam Fine Arts Museum, and Hoan Kiem Lake.

In the evening, dine at one of Hanoi's celebrated Michelin-starred establishments, sampling sophisticated northern Vietnamese gastronomy.

itinerary.title: Modern Championship Design at Silk Path Dong Trieu
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Modern Parkland
itinerary.imageCaption: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel east toward Quang Ninh province to experience the newly opened championship layout at Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf. Featuring impeccably manicured turf, sprawling sand waste areas, and subtle green complexes, this modern design delivers an exceptional championship test.

Relax in the clubhouse post-round before your private executive vehicle returns your party to Capella Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Sir Nick Faldo’s Mountain Masterpiece at Thanh Lanh Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Round 4: Northern Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Save the best for last at Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort, Sir Nick Faldo’s stunning valley course situated at 1,000 meters elevation in Vinh Phuc province. Framed by turquoise mountain lakes and towering peaks, this layout feels like a Swiss alpine course transplanted to Southeast Asia.

Celebrate the conclusion of your Northern Vietnam golf tour with drinks on the stone clubhouse terrace before returning to Hanoi for a final celebratory dinner.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Noi Bai International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a final morning coffee beside the Hanoi Opera House before checking out.

Your private executive transfer transports your group to Noi Bai International Airport for your onward flight, concluding an unforgettable week of championship golf.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year for golf in Hanoi?
faqs.answer: The autumn and winter months from October to March offer cool, dry, and pleasant golfing weather in northern Vietnam.
